query.statement: INSERT INTO TB_REPORTDEFINITION (REPORTDEFINITION_ID, NAME, STATUS_CD, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, SYSDATE, ?, SYSDATE)
SELECT REPORTDEFINITION_ID, NAME, STATUS_CD, UPDATED_AT FROM TB_REPORTDEFINITION WHERE NAME LIKE '%' || ? || '%' AND STATUS_CD = ? ORDER BY UPDATED_AT DESC
SELECT REPORTDEFINITION_ID, NAME, STATUS_CD, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT FROM TB_REPORTDEFINITION WHERE REPORTDEFINITION_ID = ?
UPDATE TB_REPORTDEFINITION SET NAME = ?, STATUS_CD = ?, UPDATED_BY = ?, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE REPORTDEFINITION_ID = ?
